title: Bed-Hold Transfer Notice and the First Held Night Reserved on Resident Funds
content:
The spare balance of a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, which caps the amount of an ancillary per-bill authorization, is reduced by the held-bed charges building up on a hold in progress under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations. Those charges build up only from **the first night allowed**, which follows the transfer notice for the hold in progress, because no night held before the transfer notice was delivered is ever charged.

The hold's first held day is the private hold start date the reservation records, or its leave start date where it records none.

| Transfer notice recorded for the reservation | First night allowed |
|---|---|
| the latest transfer notice was delivered after the hold's first held day | the delivery date |
| no transfer notice is recorded for the reservation | no night is allowed |
| otherwise (delivered on or before the first held day) | the hold's first held day |

## Both sides (hypothetical dates)

Leave start 6 August, no private hold start date recorded:

| Latest transfer notice delivered | First night allowed |
|---|---|
| 5 August | 6 August |
| 6 August | 6 August |
| 8 August | 8 August |
| none recorded | no night |
